about: Free or low-cost learning resources checked by hand on the provider's own course page. 'covers' lists the ESCO essential skills (exact labels from data/roles.json) that the course's stated learning outcomes address; the mapping was reviewed by the team and is an adapted use of ESCO. 'hours' is the study time the provider states; null means the provider states no hours. Never add a course without opening its page. 'free' is true only when the course itself can be studied at no cost; Coursera courses are paid but can be reached free through the access programme named in 'access'.
